text:
I cannot recommend Heather enough! Having her there on our wedding day creating a piece of art that we will treasure forever was such a highlight. The amount of details captured from the vases, florals, wedding dress, waterfall and fairy lights is insane! All the details that made the day feel like ours was captured.

It was so much fun for our guests to watch the painting come to life throughout the night as well. Heather was such a talented, kind, and entertaining part of our day. She was the best addition!

The planning process was super simple and your painting is fully customized to what you want! Heather is open for whatever ideas you want captured! I also loved all the little behind the scenes videos and photos she captured on our wedding day and sent to me.

If you’re considering booking a live painter, Heather is a must! It was one of my favorite parts of the day and now we have the most perfect piece of art to take us back to our wedding day!

owner_reply.text: Kylee! Thank you so so much for this very kind and thoughtful review! It was a GORGEOUS wedding and it was a true treat to paint all the details!! I hope you both enjoy the painting for years to come!!💗💗

text: From our initial phone call to the finished details, Heather was so kind to help us envision the masterpiece and even adapt when we changed things day of! The painting could not have been more perfect to capture the essence of our wedding day! Thank you so much, Heather!! The painting allows us to relive our wedding day every time we look at it!

owner_reply.text: Haley!! Your wedding was absolutely gorgeous and it was such an honor to come and paint for your guest!!! Thank you very much for letting me join💗

text:
Heather is an angel. Seriously. We had the absolute pleasure of hiring her on as our live wedding painter, something I have always wanted, and she exceeded expectations. Our guests were BLOWN away and could not stop talking about her talent. Not only is she a fabulously talented artist, but she is a wonderful person. She connected with our guests, and they all just spoke so highly of her. Her and her assistant were just an absolute joy to work with. Our day wouldn't have been the same without them.
During the whirlwind of our wedding day, we didn't get to see the painting until later during the reception, but I will never forget walking by her while she was painting when we were on the way to our grand entrance, and stopping dead in my tracks and my jaw hit the floor. I was like, 30 feet away,  and she had only been painting for a couple of hours at this point, and I was absolutely floored by how beautiful the painting looked.
The whole experience she offers to brides and grooms is so meaningful and heartfelt. She truly loves what she does, and it is evident in the service she provides.
Do yourself the biggest favor and have Heather as a part of your day.  Our painting is not only something we will cherish forever, but the memories she provided will live on forever, as well. The reaction photos are priceless. Thank you so much, Heather!

owner_reply.text: Oh Brookie!! This is sooo sooo sweet!!! Thank you so much for all your kind words!! It was such an honor to come and paint for your wedding!!! I can’t thank you enough for all your support!! 💗💗

We had Heather as our live wedding artist and honestly, it was one of our favorite parts of the day. Watching her bring everything to life in real time was so special, and the final painting came out even more beautiful than we imagined. It’s something we’ll always have to remember the day.

Our guests were obsessed and kept going up to watch her work—everyone was talking about how talented she is. It added such a fun, personal touch that made the whole day feel even more us.

If you’re thinking about having a live artist at your wedding, do it. And trust us, go with Heather. You’ll be so happy you did.
